description: Import a CSV of contacts as a new list of phones, emails, or both. The server fetches source_url over https (50 MB cap), so this changes who a project or email campaign will reach. Name phone_column, email_column, or both; there is no automatic email column detection. consent_source is optional and allowed only for an audience list with an email column. With merge_tags, phones map only the named columns while emails also map every remaining column. purpose do_not_contact turns phones into an opt-out list and emails into unsubscribes, and returns no list_id. Poll get_contact_list: import is the phone side and email.status is the email side. Requires confirm: true.

acquired.description: Optional, default false. The emails were purchased or rented; the list is sent more gradually.

brand_id.description: Scope the list to this brand.

confirm.description: Must be true to run this write operation. Set it only after the user has explicitly confirmed.

consent_note.description: Optional detail about the consent, up to 1000 characters.

consent_source.description: How the people in this file agreed to hear from you. Optional; allowed only for an audience list with an email column, refused otherwise.

email_column.description: CSV column that holds the email address.

email_domain_id.description: Scope the emails to one sending domain. Omit for the whole organization.

list_name.description: Name for the new list, 1-255 characters.

merge_tags.description: Maps CSV columns to merge fields: first_name, last_name, address, address_line_2, city, state, zip (each a CSV column name), and custom_fields [{ csv_column, merge_tag }]. Omit it and every other column gets a merge tag automatically; with it, emails still map every remaining column by default name.

organization_id.description: Target organization. Defaults to the key owner.

phone_column.description: CSV column that holds the phone number.

purpose.description: audience (the default) makes a list you can send to; do_not_contact makes opt-outs and unsubscribes.

source_url.description: https URL of the CSV file.

name: import_contact_list
